clue.text: Disrupt drunken teen lust

indicators.note: someone drunken staggers about, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Adolescent desire fuelled by drink causes chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: To disrupt something is to throw it into disorder, which is a straight synonym.

clue.text: Endlessly short-tempered, note

indicators.note: without its end, so the final letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: crotchety means irritable or short-tempered

explanation.surface: Someone irritable without pause, writing a curt message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' looks like a written message, but it is the musical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A crotchet is the British name for a quarter note in music, a musical note lasting one beat.

clue.text: Work to include current stuff in plan

parts.note: to dig is to work hard, as at an excavation

explanation.definitionFit: A diagram is a drawn plan or outline showing how something is laid out.

clue.text: Instrument not in drink

indicators.note: not here means the following word is left out of the instrument

parts.note: the clarinet is a woodwind instrument

explanation.surface: A musical instrument is missing from a drinks venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is the British name for red Bordeaux wine, a drink.

clue.text: Grass in class

parts.note: a form is a school class in Britain

explanation.surface: Lawn plants in a classroom, or a pupil telling tales on classmates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grass' looks like a plant but is the British slang verb for telling on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To grass is British slang for betraying someone to the police, which is to inform on them.

clue.text: Rascal Danny is travelling round detacheds area off Africa

indicators.note: moving about, so the letters are shifted into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A rogue named Danny tours the detached houses of a district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detacheds' appears to be a stray word in the printed clue; the anagram of RASCAL DANNY IS uses every letter of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Canaries are a Spanish archipelago lying in the Atlantic west of Morocco.

clue.text: Bird I name with painful swelling deserting

parts.note: a chicken is a domestic bird
gout is a disease causing painful swollen joints

explanation.surface: A bird gets a sore lump and runs away.
explanation.definitionFit: Chickening out means losing nerve and backing out, close to deserting a cause.

clue.text: Worshipful band of the free?

parts.note: a Christian group famous for brass bands, whose members have been saved, so are free of sin

explanation.surface: A religious group of liberated people.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on band as a musical ensemble and army as a body of people, with the saved seen as freed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Salvation Army is a Christian charity known for its brass bands and street worship.

clue.text: Rich man with time to disrobe

parts.note: Dives is the traditional name for the rich man in the Bible parable of Lazarus

explanation.surface: A wealthy man takes a moment to undress.
explanation.definitionFit: To divest oneself is to strip off clothing, so it means to undress.

clue.text: It can be ugly, wild orgy during storm

indicators.note: wild means out of control, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A frenzied party unfolds amid a tempest, and it gets ugly.
explanation.definitionFit: Gargoyles are grotesque carved stone figures on buildings, often deliberately hideous.

clue.text: Transport no end of fish

indicators.note: lacking its final letter, so the last letter of the fish goes

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A vehicle carrying a limitless supply of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A car is a means of transport, a motor vehicle.

clue.text: Picture small boat

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: An image of a little vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sketch is a rough drawing, a kind of picture.

clue.text: Trade union blocks manual working in a particular part of the year

definitions.text: in a particular part of the year

indicators.note: the union abbreviation sits inside and so obstructs the jumbled letters
working here means reworked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A union obstructs manual labour during a certain season.
explanation.definitionFit: Autumnal describes things belonging to the fall season, a particular part of the year.

clue.text: American composer thus leaving the States

indicators.note: the synonym for thus departs from the composer's name

parts.note: John Philip Sousa was the American march composer
so means thus or in this way

explanation.surface: A composer from America departs his homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: The States is a common informal name for the United States of America.

clue.text: Getting to the bottom of it thoroughly

definitions.text: Getting to the bottom of it
definitions.meaning: reaching below the surface, examining fully

explanation.surface: Investigating something completely.
explanation.definitionFit: An in-depth study is comprehensive and thorough, reaching the underlying detail.

clue.text: Lively, not starting to snoop

indicators.note: without its opening letter, so the first letter is removed

parts.note: spry means lively and active

explanation.surface: A sprightly person who is not beginning to poke around.
explanation.definitionFit: To pry is to inquire nosily into others' affairs, exactly to snoop.

clue.text: Violent doctor about to consume drink

indicators.note: the first pieces swallow the drink inside them

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
Asti is an Italian sparkling wine

explanation.surface: A brutal physician is about to down a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Drastic means severe and forceful in effect, close to violent.

clue.text: Criticise a large town for greed

parts.note: to rap is to rebuke or criticise
a city is a large town

explanation.surface: Condemning a big town for its avarice.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapacity is grasping, aggressive greed, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Sort of posh, neat carriage

indicators.note: sort here means to arrange, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A smart, tidy kind of horse-drawn vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A stanhope is a light open horse-drawn carriage, named after the clergyman it was built for.

clue.text: Dream of cleric on lake

indicators.note: in a down answer the cleric sits on top of the lake

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a cleric
Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America

explanation.surface: A clergyman's dream about a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverie is a daydream, a pleasant state of dreamy absorption.

clue.text: Eleven singly

definitions.meaning: the number is written as a 1 beside a 1, which reads as a phrase

explanation.surface: A team of eleven, taken individually.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is visual: the digits 11 are a one next to a one.
explanation.definitionFit: Singly means taking things individually, one after another in sequence.

clue.text: Made tea for family on the radio

indicators.note: broadcast so heard rather than seen, signalling a homophone

parts.note: a brood is a family of young children

explanation.definitionFit: Tea is brewed by steeping leaves in hot water, so to brew is to make tea.

clue.text: Little Katharine found in dictionary that's approved

indicators.note: the name sits inside the dictionary abbreviation

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
Kay is a short form of Katharine

explanation.surface: A girl's name turns up in the dictionary, giving it legitimacy.
explanation.definitionFit: Okayed means sanctioned or given the go-ahead, the same as approved.

clue.text: Dirge from one entering works

parts.note: IV is the Roman numeral four

clue.text: Domestic servant's introduction to website?

parts.note: home means domestic, as in home affairs

clue.text: Trouble there would be when Nick has to foot the bill

definitions.text: Trouble there would be when Nick has to foot the bill

parts.words: Trouble there would be when Nick has to foot the bill
parts.note: Old Nick is a name for Satan, so the phrase is read literally as Satan settling the bill

explanation.surface: Things go wrong when someone named Nick must cover the costs.
explanation.walkthrough: Old Nick is a traditional name for Satan.
